verdict.rationale: Runloop's own Axons give agents a persistent event stream that lets them suspend when idle and wake on demand, and Broker bridges those events to agent processes in Devboxes. That is a first-party event-driven activation mechanism, though the evidence does not show a user-defined rules or trigger engine. Configurable idle and auto-shutdown behavior adds one narrow, built-in event-to-action rule. Missing for 10: a documented way to define custom rules mapping arbitrary events to actions, trigger conditions and action types, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
